title: Junktris
status: Live — playable on the web; Android build in Google Play prep
summary: Junktris is a junk-hauling twist on falling-block puzzles: you load real-world junk — mattresses, recliners, dryers, microwaves, a rare oversized shed — into a truck, balancing how tightly you pack against the truck's axle weight limit. It was built with Claude as a single self-contained HTML file and iterated to version 60.
prompts: Coming soon — the owner will share example prompts.
iterations: Iterated to V60 (locked for release on 2026-08-24). V58 is kept unchanged as the known-good baseline, with V59 as the immediate rollback. The public repo has 66 commits.
tools: Claude; one HTML file (canvas game, audio synthesized in-browser); GitHub Pages with a PWA service worker; an Android wrapper app (target API 36) that embeds the game for offline play. Debug APK and unsigned release AAB build; signing and the Play Store listing are the remaining steps.
how_it_plays: Each turn you pick the next item from three curbside choices, then rotate, slide and drop it into the truck. Line Haul mode clears full rows; Tight Pack mode scores packed layers. Overload the axle and the load blows ("KABOOM"). Easy, Medium and Hard difficulties, one-hand left/right layouts, an in-game Junk Hauler's Guide to all 16 items, and music synthesized in-game so it works offline.
